difficulty_reason: For an open covering S = union U_i, the lemma asserts that every descent datum on quasi-coherent sheaves for the family is effective and that the functor to descent data is fully faithful (statement lines 392-401). The proof names the two inputs it uses: the general glueing theory for sheaves, and the fact that quasi-coherence is a local property (proof lines 403-407). The level is H2: short, but the two ingredients that make the statement true are identified rather than a single ready-made statement being quoted.
